# DESIGN:OS Origami

> DESIGN:OS Origami generates parametric carton dielines, printer exchange files and source-derived folding previews from Python.

Python ≥3.10 · MIT. 11 carton CLI choices: tuck-box, hex-petal, diamond-box, zero-glue-tray, gable-box, pillow-box, crash-lock-box, fefco-0201, fefco-0427, sleeve-tray, food-box. Miura-ori and deer-base are separate research patterns.

Presentation mode writes SVG, R12 DXF and viewer HTML. Printer mode writes a five-spot PDF (CutContour, CreaseLine, Perforation, Bleed, GlueArea), with 1 pt strokes, a legend and 3 mm default bleed, plus R2000 mm/y-up DXF.

Ten shown blanks have source-derived 3D previews; diamond and zero-glue tray remain unavailable. The baseline samples four positions; coordinated crash-lock motion additionally passes 101 samples and endpoint/loop closure checks, with the same 0.5 mm seam tolerance. Recipient RIP/CAD import, physical fold/fit, continuous-time motion and collision avoidance are not verified.

This index uses the planned canonical URL; publication and remote availability are not verified.

## Guides

- [Overview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/): Static marketing site and quickstart.
- [Source guide](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-origami#readme): Repository README and checkout commands.
- [Printer profile](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/printer-profile.md): Named spots, scale, bleed and recipient limits.
- [Fold preview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/fold-preview.md): Source extraction, continuity and motion limits.

## Local AI-host packages

- [Host guide index](ai-hosts/index.md): Local-only scope and qualification matrix.
- [Claude Code](ai-hosts/claude-code.md): `claude plugin marketplace add .` followed by `claude plugin install design-os-origami@design-os-origami-local`.
- [Codex CLI](ai-hosts/codex-cli.md): `codex plugin marketplace add .` followed by `codex plugin add design-os-origami@design-os-origami-local`.
- [Gemini CLI](ai-hosts/gemini-cli.md): `gemini extensions install ./bundles/gemini`. Installation/discovery observed; execution blocked by Gemini sign-in on the test machine; support unqualified.
- [Grok Build CLI](ai-hosts/grok-build.md): Generate a resolved local staging package, then `grok plugin install /absolute/new-local-plugin --trust`; official binary required.
- [Claude Desktop](ai-hosts/claude-desktop.md) and [Cursor](ai-hosts/cursor.md): `python3 scripts/host_config.py --host HOST --workspace /absolute/artifact-workspace --browser-cache /absolute/user-cache`, then manual local configuration.
- [Host smoke](ai-hosts/verification.md): Discovery, real execution, invalid-input rejection, artifacts and look sheet; installation alone does not establish support.

## Real generated examples

- [Carton catalogue](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/assets/catalog.json): 12 blanks with dimensions, caliper, paths and sampled-continuity results.
- [Model switcher](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/demo/index.html): Standalone 2D/3D viewer; requires JavaScript, WebGL and pinned Three.js r128 CDN for 3D.
- [Tuck-box SVG](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/assets/models/tuck-box.svg): Full presentation blank.
- [Tuck-box printer PDF](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/assets/models/tuck-box.pdf): Vector spot-colour exchange example.
- [Tuck-box printer DXF](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/assets/models/tuck-box.dxf): R2000 mm/y-up exchange example.
